expectations.text: States the revised ESRS are now LAW: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563, published in the Official Journal September 21, 2026, entering into force November 10, 2026
expectations.evidence: "Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563... Published in the Official Journal on 21 September 2026. Enters into force on 10 November 2026"

expectations.text: States application correctly: revised ESRS mandatory for financial years beginning on or after January 1, 2027
expectations.evidence: "the revised ESRS apply to financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2027" / "FY2027... Revised ESRS (mandatory)"

expectations.text: States the FY2026 choice: undertakings may apply EITHER the 2023 ESRS (as amended) OR the revised ESRS for financial years starting in 2026
expectations.evidence: "for FY2026 you may choose between the 2023 ESRS (as amended) and the revised, simplified ESRS"

expectations.text: Quantifies the simplification with the final-act figures: mandatory datapoints cut from over 1,000 to roughly 320 (>60% reduction in mandatory datapoints; >70% total), with former voluntary datapoints removed to EFRAG non-mandatory guidance — not the draft-stage 57-61% figures
expectations.evidence: "mandatory datapoints are cut from over 1,000 to roughly 320, which is more than 60% fewer mandatory datapoints and more than 70% fewer in total. Former voluntary datapoints have moved to EFRAG's non-mandatory guidance"

expectations.text: Gives practical basis-decision advice (e.g., early-adopting the revised ESRS for FY2026 avoids a one-year-only report on the old standards)
expectations.evidence: "No double build. You would otherwise do a 2023-basis report in FY2026 and then rebuild for FY2027" plus mapping-exercise advice
